guidance.viewpoint: Third-person limited, past tense, closely anchored to the active viewpoint character.
guidance.narrative_distance: Close-to-medium. Permit direct interior thought, reasoning, uncertainty, memory, and explicitly recognized emotion.
guidance.diction: Accessible, concrete fantasy prose with predominantly plainspoken contemporary readability. Avoid unnecessarily ornate or conspicuously literary diction.
guidance.sentence_rhythm: Favor conventional complete sentences with natural variation. Permit longer reflective passages when the viewpoint character is reasoning through events; use fragments selectively rather than as an intensity default.
guidance.paragraphing: Allow substantial paragraphs for connected observation or interior reasoning, balanced with shorter dialogue and action paragraphs.
guidance.description: Use concrete sensory, spatial, and physical details selected through viewpoint. Employ occasional straightforward simile or metaphor without saturating the prose in figurative language.
guidance.interiority: Make character reasoning a substantial part of the prose. Permit explicit questions, competing explanations, reconsideration, uncertainty, and direct recognition of feelings.
guidance.dialogue: Keep dialogue direct, informal where appropriate, and character-specific. Allow hesitation, repetition, interruption, irritation, humor, incomplete thoughts, and imperfect phrasing rather than polishing every utterance.
guidance.action: Render physical action chronologically and spatially clearly. Emphasize understandable movement, cause, and consequence over rapid cinematic fragments.
guidance.emotion: Emotional states may sometimes be stated directly. Do not require emotion to be encoded exclusively through gestures or automatic physiological reactions.
guidance.pacing: Permit alternation between concrete action or dialogue and sustained reflection. Do not force uniformly rapid scene pacing.
guidance.tone: Earnest, immersive, character-centered storytelling. Prefer readable narrative immediacy over detached literary display.
guidance.normalization: Do not reproduce spelling errors, grammatical accidents, continuity slips, or other obvious drafting defects from source samples.
